title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-ergonomics-v1.172.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Parallel SDK updates across Python, TypeScript and Go to unify auth/retries behavior, stabilize streaming ergonomics, and bump SDK versions to v1.172.0. Motivation: Several customers hit token-expiry and streaming-reconnect edge cases when combining long-lived streaming sessions and transient auth failures. This PR implements a consistent retry/backoff policy, centralizes token refresh behavior, improves streaming client ergonomics (iterator helpers and reconnect backoff), and aligns public surface areas across language SDKs so parity tests can run reliably. Changes include: 1) Python: new AuthRetryMiddleware that refreshes tokens transparently and retries idempotent requests with exponential backoff and jitter; streaming client exposes an async iterator with automatic reconnect and resume-from-offset when supported by the server; updated docs and migration notes. 2) TypeScript: exported StreamingClient helper with for-await-of support, unified retry policy implementation shared via common/http utils, and better TypeScript generics for response parsing. 3) Go: added RetryTransport wrapper with token- refresh hook, streaming client returns a reconnecting Reader with context-aware cancelation; cleaned up examples. 4) Tests: added unit and e2e tests simulating token expiry, 401+retry flows, and streaming interruptions; CI includes flaky-tolerant e2e step. 5) Release: bumped SDK package versions to v1.172.0 across languages and updated changelogs. Checklist: [x] implement retry/token refresh in Python, TypeScript, Go; [x] add streaming ergonomics helpers; [x] add unit and e2e tests; [x] update docs and migration guide; [x] bump versions and changelogs; [x] run cross-language parity tests and fix failing cases. Notes: this is non-breaking for most users but includes a small behavioral change where retries for non-idempotent requests are still opt-in; doc highlights the default policy and how to opt-out. Linear: ENG-1720 tracks rollout and monitoring.
